arxiv-2002-12164.title: Performance Analysis of Semi-supervised Learning in the Small-data Regime using VAEs
arxiv-2002-12164.creator: Varun Mannam, Arman Kazemi
arxiv-2002-12164.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Varun Mannam, Arman Kazemi. Extracting large amounts of data from biological samples is not feasible due to radiation issues, and image processing in the small-data regime is one of the critical challenges when working with a limited amount of data. In this work, we applied an existing algorithm named Variational Auto Encoder (VAE) that pre-trains a latent space representation of the data that captures the features in a lower-dimension for the small-data regime input.

arxiv-2106-10695.title: Bloch oscillations in the spin-1/2 XXZ chain
arxiv-2106-10695.creator: Yankang Liu, Yohei Fuji, Haruki Watanabe
arxiv-2106-10695.description: Abstract Under a perfect periodic potential, the electric current density induced by a constant electric field may exhibit nontrivial oscillations, so-called Bloch oscillations, with an amplitude that remains nonzero in the large system size limit. Such oscillations have been well studied for nearly noninteracting particles and observed in experiments. In this work, we revisit Bloch oscillations in strongly interacting systems.

arxiv-2303-14021.title: Forward-Backward algorithms for weakly convex problems
arxiv-2303-14021.creator: Ewa Bednarczuk, Giovanni Bruccola, Gabriele Scrivanti, The Hung Tran
arxiv-2303-14021.description: Abstract We investigate the convergence properties of exact and inexact forward-backward algorithms to minimise the sum of two weakly convex functions defined on a Hilbert space, where one has a Lipschitz-continuous gradient. We show that the exact forward-backward algorithm converges strongly to a global solution, provided that the objective function satisfies a sharpness condition.

arxiv-2308-12316.title: Graph Neural Stochastic Differential Equations
arxiv-2308-12316.creator: Richard Bergna, Felix L. Opolka, Pietro Liò, Jose Miguel Hernandez-Lobato
arxiv-2308-12316.description: Abstract We present a novel model Graph Neural Stochastic Differential Equations (Graph Neural SDEs). This technique enhances the Graph Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (Graph Neural ODEs) by embedding randomness into data representation using Brownian motion. This inclusion allows for the assessment of prediction uncertainty, a crucial aspect frequently missed in current models.

arxiv-2309-05674.title: ConvFormer: Plug-and-Play CNN-Style Transformers for Improving Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2309-05674.creator: Xian Lin, Zengqiang Yan (🖂), Xianbo Deng, Chuansheng Zheng, Li Yu
arxiv-2309-05674.description: Abstract Transformers have been extensively studied in medical image segmentation to build pairwise long-range dependence. Yet, relatively limited well-annotated medical image data makes transformers struggle to extract diverse global features, resulting in attention collapse where attention maps become similar or even identical.

arxiv-2408-08262.title: Coarsening and parallelism with reduction multigrids for hyperbolic Boltzmann transport Note: UK Ministry of Defence © Crown owned copyright 2024/AWE
arxiv-2408-08262.creator: S. Dargaville, R.P. Smedley-Stevenson, P.N. Smith, C.C. Pain
arxiv-2408-08262.description: Abstract Reduction multigrids have recently shown good performance in hyperbolic problems without the need for Gauss-Seidel smoothers. When applied to the hyperbolic limit of the Boltzmann Transport Equation (BTE), these methods result in very close to 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ) \mathcal{O}(n) growth in work with problem size on unstructured grids.

arxiv-2502-14556.title: Exploring the phase diagram of S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) 4 SU(2)_{4} strange correlator
arxiv-2502-14556.creator: Ce Shen
arxiv-2502-14556.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ce Shen. We investigate the phase diagram of a quantum many-body system constructed via the strange correlator approach, based on the non-Abelian S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) 4 SU(2)_{4} fusion category, to probe topological phase transitions. Using tensor network methods, we numerically compute the half-infinite chain entanglement entropy derived from the dominant eigenvector of the transfer matrix and map the entropy across a spherical two-dimensional parameter space.

arxiv-2512-05005.title: Millimetre-Wave Comb Generated by an Optical Microcomb
arxiv-2512-05005.creator: L. Peters, A. Cutrona, A. R. Cooper, L. Olivieri, F. Getman, V. Cecconi, N. Paul, D. Das, M. Rowley, S. T. Chu, B. E. Little, R. Morandotti, D. J. Moss, J. S. Totero Gongora, A. Pasquazi, M. Peccianti
arxiv-2512-05005.description: Abstract Metrological-grade millimetre wave baseband comb sources covering the sub-terahertz window are a key building block for next-generation wireless communications, precision sensing, and positioning systems. While optical microcombs have set new benchmarks in ultra-low phase noise single-frequency microwave generation, to date, no microcomb source has directly produced a millimetre-wave baseband comb.

pmc-11645288.title: Adjunctive Diagnosis of Mycobacterium gordonae Pneumonia by Metagenomic Next-Generation Sequencing in an Immunocompetent Patient: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-11645288.creator: Shengqiao Shi, Wei Gai, Hui Huang, Yafeng Zheng, Xiaojing Zhang, Yuanrong Dai, Chengyun Wu
pmc-11645288.description: IntroductionMycobacterium gordonae is a nonpathogenic pathogen commonly found in nature and is generally considered a contaminant in clinical practice. Although there have been few reported cases of infection, most of them are secondary to immunosuppression. This paper described a rare case of globular shadow in the chest of an immunocompetent male who was diagnosed with M. gordonae pulmonary disease.

pmc-12625960.title: Effectiveness of SMS reminders to increase demand for HPV immunisation: a randomised controlled trial in Georgia
pmc-12625960.creator: Niall Daly, Sarah Merriam, Giulia Tagliaferri, Sergiu Tomsa, Viviane M Bianco, Lika Gamgebeli, Nino Lortkipanidze

pmc-12733212.title: Functional Variation in RGS12 Should Not Preclude Methylphenidate Use in Bipolar Disorder with Established Mood Stabilization: Preclinical Evidence
pmc-12733212.creator: Percy S Agogo-Mawuli, Joshua D Gross, Vincent Setola, Bryan J Gall, David P Siderovski, James Alan Bourgeois
pmc-12733212.description: Our goal in this study was to determine whether functional variation in the human RGS12 gene influences behavioral responses to psychostimulants such as methylphenidate, thereby informing whether such genetic findings should affect the clinical use of this central nervous system (CNS)-stimulating agent in bipolar disorder (BD) patients with comorbid attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD).

pmc-12734460.title: Assessment of Residual Oxidative Stress in Patients with Well-Controlled Hypertension: A Pilot Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12734460.creator: Wuthichai Preechakul, Putcharawipa Maneesai, Poungrat Pakdeechote, Weerapon Sangartit, Metee Iampanichakul, Kittisak Sawanyawisuth, Somchai Ruangwannasak, Sittichai Khamsai
pmc-12734460.description: Background/Objectives: Although hypertension is linked to oxidative stress, it remains unclear whether this pro-oxidant state persists after achieving recommended blood pressure (BP) control. This pilot study aimed to explore the presence of residual oxidative stress in patients with well-controlled hypertension compared to normotensive individuals.

pmc-13014970.title: PKA activation rescues myocardial injury elicited by silica nanoparticles through improving oxidative stress, mitochondrial health, and copper homeostasis
pmc-13014970.creator: Caixia Guo, Xinying Zhao, Yawen Zhu, Miao Chen, Yanbo Li
pmc-13014970.description: Silica nanoparticles (SiNPs), as one of the most widely produced nanomaterials globally, have garnered widespread attention for their potential toxicity. Epidemiological and experimental evidence have illuminated that exposure to SiNPs can lead to cardiovascular toxicity, though the precise underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We previously identified PKA as a crucial regulator in SiNPs-elicited myocardial injury.

pmc-13082883.title: INTERLACE Study: Real-world Data for Germany Based on a Case Series of Patients with Locally Advanced Cervical Cancer
pmc-13082883.creator: Alina Lohner, Volkmar Müller, Andrea Baehr, David Krug, Cordula Petersen, Anna Jaeger, Barbara Schmalfeldt, Charlotte Sachs, Linn Woelber
pmc-13082883.description: Introduction Primary chemoradiotherapy is the established and standard treatment for locally advanced cervical cancer. The INTERLACE study investigated the impact of adding induction chemotherapy with six cycles of carboplatin AUC2 and paclitaxel 80 mg/m 2 weekly prior to chemoradiotherapy on recurrence-free and overall survival. However, adaptation with adoption into routine clinical practice in Germany has been rather cautious.

pmc-13399055.creator: Panyun Wu, Yang Wang, Jonathan C Cohen, Helen H Hobbs
pmc-13399055.description: Background & Aims:PNPLA3(I148M) is the strongest genetic risk factor for steatotic liver disease (SLD), but its functional role and tissue-specific regulation remain unclear. Pnpla3 mRNA levels are significantly higher in mouse adipose tissue than in liver tissue, yet its role in adipose tissue is not known.

pmc-13696523.title: Feasibility and Preliminary Effectiveness of a Data-to-Care Intervention for HIV-Positive People Who Inject Drugs in Ukraine: A Pilot Cluster-Randomized Trial
pmc-13696523.creator: Kostyantyn Dumchev, Brian Weir, Khushee Prasad, Shannon Fuller, Farren Rodrigues, Julia Burlaka, Olena Makarenko, Tetiana Kiriazova, Jill Owczarzak
pmc-13696523.description: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) interruptions are common among people who inject drugs (PWID) and contribute to viral rebound, disease progression, and onward transmission. Data-to-Care (D2C) strategies, which use routine health data to identify and re-engage people living with HIV who have fallen out of care, are widely used in high-income settings but rarely evaluated in low- and middle-income countries.
